title: New breast cancer diagnoses and treatment report
publisher: Te Whatu Ora Health New Zealand - BreastScreen Aotearoa
bounded_claims: The report contains anti-HER2 treatment proportions for defined BreastScreen subgroup populations.
The report is not a national treatment-mix or service-capability dataset.
claim_boundary: Public subgroup treatment context only; no national formulation mix, observed capacity, eligibility, provider travel, or operational recommendation is derived.
